Message ReportVisualSensorCapabilities

Message ID: 4806h

Description:
This message is used to report the sensors’ capabilities upon reciept of a Query Visual Sensor Capabilities message. Capabilities include sensor properties, values and ranges which can be modified by the Set Range Sensor Configuration message.
